name: Adventurer
description: Master of none. Trains and fights with both Physical and Arcane, but neither school gets a specialization bonus.

name: Warrior
description: Weapons only. Physical abilities deal x{bonus} damage. Arcane attributes and spells are locked, and Arcane stats on gear do nothing.

name: Mage
description: Spells only. Spells deal x{bonus} damage. Physical attributes and weapon abilities are locked, and Physical stats on gear do nothing.
